name: InfraDash Self-Hosted Infrastructure Dashboard
free_limit: Self-hostable infrastructure inventory and visual dashboard for servers, VMs, disks, IP addresses and network connections, with user roles and optional separate monitoring agent. Source available under GPL-3.0; no vendor software quota or expiry documented.
watch_out: Free software only: no VPS, VM, hosting, storage or bandwidth included. Requires your own Docker/Compose host, PostgreSQL and HTTPS reverse proxy; infrastructure costs apply. Change seeded default credentials and secrets before deployment. Upstream README says MIT but actual LICENSE file is GPL-3.0; follow LICENSE and review obligations before redistribution or commercial integration. Monitoring and integrations include roadmap items, not all shipped features.
